content.short: Pushing the boundaries of your NFT experience. Own a piece of apartment that you can sell, on your own terms.
content.description:
CardanoDistrict is an upcoming interactive NFT apartment series with a metaverse that is close to realism. With a collection of 10,000 unique designs spread across 8 different seasons, players can roam around freely, discover different apartments, and trade within a marketplace all in the same space. At Cardanodistrict, our team of talented artists, 3D Generalists and Software Engineers strive towards a common goal — to deliver the best user experience.

CardanoDistrict NFTs are stored as CIP-721 tokens on the Cardano blockchain and hosted on IPFS.
